findings.message: Format SQL queries using parameterized binding rather than string concatenation.

resolutions.reason: no alternation; no role resolution required
resolutions.rationale: Server-side coding flaw allowing data->code transition in DB query (SQL is code). Explicitly #2 in Whitepaper.

findings.message: User-supplied data is rendered into the response without contextual escaping.

resolutions.reason: no glob match; fell back to default_role=server
resolutions.rationale: Reflected/Stored XSS exploits a server-side coding flaw (#2) to deliver a script that the browser executes (#7). DOM-based XSS exploits a client-side coding flaw (#3).

findings.message: DOM sink receives data from a URL parameter without sanitization.

resolutions.rationale: Reflected/Stored XSS exploits a server-side coding flaw (#2) to deliver a script that the browser executes (#7). DOM-based XSS exploits a client-side coding flaw (#3).

findings.message: Hardcoded AWS access key detected in source.

resolutions.reason: no alternation; no role resolution required
resolutions.rationale: Hard-coded credentials baked into the product (passwords, API keys, cryptographic keys) — once extracted from binaries/firmware, every deployment becomes impersonable. Decision tree Q3 -> #4.

findings.message: Deserialization of untrusted data without integrity verification.

resolutions.rationale: Implementation flaw deserializing attacker-controlled bytes into language objects, triggering gadget-chain code execution (e.g., Java/Python pickle). Server-role (#2) or client-role (#3) per R-ROLE. Per R-EXEC, append → #7.

findings.message: Dependency declared without an integrity-verifying checksum or signature.

resolutions.reason: no alternation; no role resolution required
resolutions.rationale: Trust acceptance event (#10): the product loads functionality (library, script, plugin) from outside its intended security domain. Per R-EXEC, included functionality runs in the host's execution context — append → #7.

low_confidence.message: Validate inputs against an allow list before use.

resolutions.reason: CWE is Discouraged and maps to N/A (too generic for a single cluster)
resolutions.rationale: Too generic to map. Input validation failures are the root cause for #2 (Injection), #3 (Client-side XSS), #6 (DoS), and #1 (Logic abuse).
